submission.justification:
Mixture-G2 with a 2.2 mm gas gap achieves the best time resolution of 0.876 ns among all tested configurations. The simulation results show that Mixture-G2 consistently outperforms both G1 and G3 across all gap widths tested (1.0-3.0 mm). Through refined optimization around the initial best performance at 2.0 mm (0.888 ns), the 2.2 mm gap was identified as optimal with a 0.876 ns resolution. This configuration provides:
1. Superior time resolution: 0.876 ns vs G3's best of 1.282 ns (2.0 mm) and G1's best of 2.064 ns (2.5 mm)
2. Compliance with all safety and environmental policies as verified
3. Gas gap well within the specified 1-3 mm constraint
4. Compatibility with the laboratory's high-voltage system (max 12 kV)
5. Benefits from the 90% gas recirculation recovery system
The 2.2 mm gap represents an optimal balance in the performance curve, sitting at the minimum of the resolution vs. gap relationship for Mixture-G2.
